title: water
description: State of the station's water point (M9): water quality and its verdict, the valve, the dispensing session, the filter. The valve can open only while the verdict is ok.
x-rate: every 5 s (every second while water flows), and at once on any change

valve_open.description: The outlet valve is open: water is flowing to a household.

session.description: The household card being served, or null.

litres.description: Dispensed so far in this session.

quota_left_l.description: What the card may still draw today, this session included.

filter.description: The filter cartridge (identified by its NTAG213 tag).

tag.description: The filter's label, or the end of its tag's UID. null: no filter fitted.

state.description: expiring: past 90 % of its capacity. expired or none: no water.

litres.description: Water through this filter so far.

dispensed_today_l.description: All the water given out today (station's local day).

card.description: The card's label, or the end of its UID (…B2C3): never the whole UID.

quality.description: Water quality at the outlet and the gate's verdict.

verdict.description: unknown: a sensor is missing or silent; the valve stays closed.

reason.description: Why, in a few words. Empty when ok.
